matched_properties.description: 3-bedroom detached house on Bramerton Street with a principal suite with dressing room and solar panels, within easy reach of the King's Road.
6-bedroom terraced house on Bramerton Street with a south-facing garden and an indoor pool, within easy reach of the King's Road.
3-bedroom semi-detached house on Bramerton Street with a kitchen/family room opening onto the garden and a home office, within easy reach of the King's Road.

history.content: Hello Grace! Welcome to Ashcombe & Rowe Estates. Are you looking to buy or sell a home?
Do you have a specific property in mind?
Are you looking for a new-build or a resale home?
What are the Chelsea branch opening hours?

Our Chelsea branch is open Monday to Friday from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm, Saturdays from 10:00 am to 5:00 pm, and Sundays from 11:00 am to 3:00 pm. It is our only location open on Sundays. What is your budget, Grace?
What is the postcode of your location of interest?

Great news, Grace, we have available resale homes in that area:
• Rosemount House - 3 bed detached house at £3,345,000
• 89 Bramerton Street - 6 bed terraced house at £5,195,000
• 56 Bramerton Street - 3 bed semi-detached house at £2,330,000

Can I get your phone number so our team can follow up with details?
Thank you! Can I get your email address?
Someone will get in touch within 24 hours via phone or email. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thank you for chatting with us. Goodbye.
